objective: Replace Marites fullscreen prev/next arrows with horizontal swipes; replace regular Android Wall video square fullscreen button with direct video tap without intercepting IMA ad taps.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source SHA 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61; source-only no installed runtime or active EAS channel evidence; no production release.
chosenApproach: Passive root touch direction guard for one-finger horizontal swipe, photo-page edge guard and zoom/reaction suppression; preserve established fullscreen video resume path on tap; leave IMA ad video native touch unchanged.
selectionRationale: No new native modules and no aggressive parent Pan handler that would steal pinch or ad gestures.
alternativeApproaches: Replace Marites with nested paged FlatList (rejected: photo scroll and video decoder lifecycle churn).
Global swipe Pan recognizer (rejected: higher risk of intercepting zoom and gestures).
Keep square video/fullscreen arrows (rejected per owner UX request).
preserveBehaviors: Inner photo paging and zoom retained
Marites audio, ad/native player and close handling retained
Video playback resume and offscreen unmount retained
acceptanceChecks: Swipe left/right through story cards including video and text; no arrows
Multi-photo swipes navigate photos; edge swipes advance story; pinch and vertical movements never advance
Regular video taps fullscreen, progress is preserved
TypeScript/Android Expo bundle, regression tests and staging source/runtime gates pass before publish

preservedBehaviors: zoom, comments, audio, ads, playback preserved

releaseTarget: Android staging-user runtime 1.3.2 only; no production push.
